integrations.name: Google Calendar MCP
setup: Resolve and pin an upstream package version before installation
Use an isolated module directory and explicit credentials and token paths
Prepare a Google Cloud project with Calendar API and desktop OAuth client
Guide the user through account selection and browser consent
Register in the assistant Herald scope and verify list-calendars and a limited list-events call
user_decisions: Which Google account and calendars to use

integrations.name: Google Workspace CLI
setup: Install the google-workspace optional CLI module (pinned upstream 0.22.5)
Use its isolated GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_CONFIG_DIR and CLOUDSDK_CONFIG under persistent module data
Prepare Google Cloud Desktop OAuth registration through supported auth setup or Cloud Console
Run auth login -s gmail,calendar with user account selection and consent
Enable only after both Gmail profile and Calendar list live checks succeed
integrations.notes: Upstream is not an officially supported Google product. A local owner catalog can install the built archive before publication. The module uses the native CLI through run_optional_module; it does not replace the assistant provider. Send mail only on an explicit request to send.

integrations.name: Kimai time tracking
integrations.runtime: Existing hosted or self-hosted app with REST API; needs an adapter
setup: Ask whether the user already uses Kimai or wants a full time-tracking app
Connect an existing instance before proposing a new deployment
Guide creation of a dedicated API token and keep it out of chat
Verify authenticated timesheet retrieval over HTTPS
Expose selected API actions through Herald using a reviewed adapter
user_decisions: Whether a separate full app is wanted

integrations.name: Actual Budget
integrations.runtime: Actual sync server plus Node.js 22+ official CLI
setup: Ask whether the user already has Actual or wants to use it
Resolve and pin the official CLI version in a module-owned directory
Use a dedicated local configuration and cache folder
Connect the selected sync server and budget
Verify account or transaction listing before writes; bank sync is a separate optional request
user_decisions: Which budget and server to use
Manual/file-based imports or optional bank connection
integrations.notes: Actual offers a Node API and CLI, not a conventional REST API. User-facing budgeting remains separate from FlowFuse investing.

integrations.name: Community Actual Budget MCP bridge
integrations.runtime: Node.js stdio MCP connecting to Actual Budget
setup: Review and pin a compatible bridge release; this is a community integration
Connect only the user's selected Actual instance
Configure module-owned bridge storage and start using --stdio
Register with the assistant scope and verify live read-only discovery and one account read
Do not initiate bank sync or mutations from discovery alone
user_decisions: Whether to use the community bridge instead of the official CLI

integrations.name: Firefly III and Data Importer
integrations.runtime: Self-hosted application and separate importer with CLI/API
setup: Prefer connecting an existing user instance
Configure the importer using that instance's dedicated access token
Begin with user-selected file imports; third-party bank providers are optional
Verify retrieval before importing or changing records
user_decisions: Whether the user wants this full app
Which files or accounts to import
